g.text: Fast typed judgments instead of slow free text
a chat LLM: writes free text token by
output must be parsed by software
a System One model: returns a typed
decision (a choice, a yes/no, a score)
• typed probabilistic judgments that software can use directly
• trained with RL for calibrated probabilities
• 'Jev' after the economist Jevons: cheaper decisions → many more uses
• image versions: Visual Jev, PixelJev → this paper: video
VideoJev (arXiv:2610.18615), §1 and §4; TypeSafe AI blog (vendor description of Jev)
